before_opening_compose: Select off-release private vault roots for outbound sent copy, transport trace, delivery status or DSN, and inbound raw reply; do not write the roots into the public release.
Recheck the public locator and record only public-source URL, timestamp, and non-authorizing route-fit status in the public shell.
before_clicking_send: Recompute exact_body_sha256, mail_ready_draft_sha256, payload manifest hash, and each payload item hash.
Confirm human signature covers recipient, subject, body hash, payload hashes, sender role, route-fit review, conflict review, deadline policy, and public-shell limits.
Confirm sender authority and account/channel without publishing account-private provider credentials, browser sessions, or private vault paths.
Confirm the mail compose window body and attachments match the audited hashes immediately before clicking send.
immediately_after_send: Export or capture the sent copy into the off-release outbound-sent-copy vault before public packaging.
Record sent_at_utc and local timestamp, sender account or role, recipient, subject, exact body hash, mail-ready draft hash, and payload item hashes.
Capture Message-ID or provider equivalent when available; if absent, capture a provider sent-export hash or comparable provider trace.
Capture attachment disposition from the sent copy rather than relying on the draft manifest alone.
Store transport/provider trace, message-id/header source, and any provider receipt in the off-release transport-trace vault.
Stage only public send-proof/send-trace shells containing hashes, sizes, timestamps, and non-authorizing metadata.
before_reading_any_reply: Prepare the inbound-raw-reply vault root outside the release tree before opening or exporting reply bytes.
Capture raw reply headers or provider-equivalent metadata and raw SHA-256 before summary, redaction, or paraphrase.
Classify DSN, auto-ack, decline, referral, conditional-retention, substantive-willingness, redacted-only, and protocol/tool outputs through response triage.
Publish only hash/size/MIME/public-shell fields unless a later separate authority permits more.

required_private_vault_roots.purpose: sent message export or provider sent-copy evidence
provider trace, Message-ID/header source, SMTP or equivalent transport proof
delivery status, DSN, bounce, ticket, read receipt, or provider status export
raw inbound reply bytes, full headers, and any counterparty conditions before redaction

send_proof_acceptance_tests.failure_if_missing: no sent timestamp; response clock remains closed
sent copy cannot be matched to authorized request
attachment swap or omission cannot be excluded
payload delivery state cannot be represented

allowed_public_shell_fields: transport proof hash or provider-equivalent hash

operator_failure_routes: If private vault roots are not selected, do not send; keep send-proof state not-sent-no-proof.
If compose body or attachment hashes drift, regenerate public payload manifest and authorization card before any send.
If Message-ID/provider equivalent is absent after send, capture a provider sent export hash and mark transport proof partial rather than starting a response clock blindly.
If a reply is opened before raw capture path exists, quarantine the event as evidence-handling defect and do not create custody/intake/import/floor effect.
public_summary: rev0260 turns the transport-proof blocker into an executable capture plan: it enumerates the required send-copy, transport-trace, delivery/DSN, and inbound-reply evidence classes while keeping all private roots unselected, all raw bytes outside the public release tree, and no send/contact/clock/custody/intake/import/floor effect.
